word_count_policy: Prose only; excludes headings, equations, and citations. Part of an overall 6500-word main-text budget (Introduction through Conclusion) set by the user.

reporting_guidelines.name: None applicable (not a biomedical or clinical study design)
reporting_guidelines.applicability: M6 is a computational hydrogeochemical field-transfer and robustness benchmark applied to real aquifer chemistry data; no EQUATOR-listed guideline applies to this study design.

required_supplementary_sections: S1. Data harmonisation, unit conversion and ion-name crosswalk
S2. Independent charge-balance error calculation and QC-tier classification
S3. Evidence-tier ladder and inference-unit definitions
S4. Sparse inverse reaction estimator and transferred identifiability classification
S5. Evidence-lift gate and tracer-corroboration rules
S7. Robustness and circularity diagnostics (evidence-gate on/off, structural diagnostics, bootstrap confidence intervals)
S11. Within-campaign seasonal hold-forward benchmark (reused M7.2 protocol)
S14. Removal of borrowed antecedent-study fields
S15. Reproducibility protocol and computational environment

equations.purpose: Defines the Cl-conservative transport-corrected reactive residual (inference-unit input)
Defines the penalised sparse bounded reaction-extent estimator
Independent charge-balance error formula and QC-tier thresholds
Standardised diagnostic design vector and MRS/class-score projection
Deuterium-excess evaporation corroboration rule referenced to the global meteoric water line
